    *   **Formula:** `[(Last Quarter Revenue - Previous Quarter Revenue) / Previous Quarter Revenue] × 100`

*   **Year-over-Year (YoY) Growth:**
    *   **Formula:** `[(Last Quarter Revenue - Same Quarter Last Year Revenue) / Same Quarter Last Year Revenue] × 100`

### 2. Retention Metrics

*   **Gross Revenue Retention (GRR):** Measures how much revenue you retain from existing clients, excluding any expansion or upsells. It shows how well you are preventing churn and downgrades (Max is 100%).
